clips.title: The story
paras: Along Darkshore’s wild borders, Sentinel Aynasha scouts the dangers threatening night elven lands. She watches enemy movements and carries urgent intelligence across the frontier.

Sentinel Aynasha scouts and fights with the Sentinels where night elven lands meet hostile incursions. She carries urgent messages across rough country and watches for enemy patrols. Her skill with a bow and her knowledge of survival help her cross contested ground.
